Commentary.Commentary: That is it for today. India have now gone 4-0 up in this series and will be eager to whitewash this Sri Lankan side. For the home side, a loss today has dampened their chances of direct qualification for the 2019 World Cup. They will have to put all that behind and come out fighting in the next game which will be played on 3rd September, 2017 at 1430 local time (0900 GMT). Do join us for it. Till then, take care and cheers!

Man of the Match, Virat Kohli says it was another good game for them. Mentions they did not want to be complacent. Admits they wanted to bat first as the pitch looked amazing for batting. Reckons it was a good toss to win and they got plenty of runs on the board which put the team chasing, under pressure. Ends by informing they will continue to experiment with the side.

Lasith Malinga admits that 300 ODI wickets is a special moment and he still looks forward to continue playing for the nation. Adds that it's difficult to motivate the team as they haven't scored 250-plus in the last 5 matches. Mentions that the youngsters were excited and hence they couldn't perform to their potential. He hopes that they come back stronger and perform well for their nation in the coming matches.

The Indian bowlers were on the money again. Shardul Thakur had a great debut, picking up a wicket and going under 4 runs per over. Jasprit Bumrah, Hardik Pandya and Kuldeep Yadav each scalped a couple of wickets with Axar Patel getting one. Their fielding was also good this time around and they inflicted two run outs as well. Also a talking point of this match would be their use of UDRS, which was spot on, thanks to Dhoni. Stay tuned for the presentation!

Angelo Mathews then stood tall in the middle. He combined well with Milinda Siriwardana and stitched a 73-run stand for the 5th wicket. After the latter departed, the ex-skipper carried on and reached his 34th ODI fifty. However, he kept running out of partners and in the end lost his way as well. After that, the Indians bowled out the Islanders in a hurry.

And the domination continues... India outplayed Sri Lanka and have handed them their biggest-ever home defeat by runs in ODIs. After posting a mammoth total of 375 on the board, India continued their good work with the ball. Their bowlers made full use of the scoreboard pressure and were off to a superb start, scalping three early wickets.

OUT! An emphatic victory for India! Loopy ball on off, turning back in. Malinga is way too early in the slog sweep. As a result, he misses it completely and the ball goes on to rattle the stumps. Two-in-two for Kuldeep but he won't be on a hat-trick as Sri Lanka have been bowled out here. INDIA WIN BY 168 RUNS!
Lasith Malinga is the last man in.

OUT! Another one bites the dust! Slower through the air on off, turning back in. Fernando tries to drive but fails to read it. Gets it off the inner half straight back to the bowler and Kuldeep takes the catch with ease. The Lankans are nine down now.
Fernando works it with the spin towards square leg for no run.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Floats it up outside off, Fernando goes inside out over extra cover for a boundary.
Shorter in length on middle, Dananjaya pulls it over mid-wicket for a brace.
FOUR! DRILLED! Short again on off, Danajaya slams it back past the bowler and the ball races to the fence.
Shortish length outside off, Dananjaya tries to pull it out of Colombo but misses.
A snorter! Goes wide of the crease and bangs it short. Fernando takes his eyes off the ball and tries to fend it. The ball takes the glove and goes down towards fine leg for a run.
Vishwa Fernando is the new man in.

OUT! Bumrah continues taking wickets. He has had a gala time with the ball in this series. Persists with the short ball around off, Pushpakumara tries to ramp it but hits it straight to the man at third man. Pandya stationed there runs forward and takes it comfortably. India are inching close to victory here.
Bowls a well-directed bouncer, Dananjaya tucks it towards square leg for a run.
Bowls a googly but shorter in length on off, Pushpakumara pushes it off the back foot through covers for a brace.
Tosses it up on off, Pushpakumara drives it back to the bowler.
Plays the sweep but hits it straight to square leg.
Drags his length back, Akila cuts it through point for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Dananjaya drives it to point.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled. Now a maximum of 5 players can be placed outside the circle.
Lands it on a length around off, Pushpakumara tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Bangs it a short ball, Malinda does well to evade it.
Bowls a full toss on leg stump, Pushpakumara flicks it to square leg.

Lands it on a length outside off, Pushpakumara tries to guide it down to third man but is beaten by the inward movement. The ball strikes him on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire shakes his head. Impact was the issue.
Bowls a full toss on leg stump, Pushpakumara misses the flick and is struck on the pads. The Indians appeal but nothing from the umpire. I feel it is going down.
Back of a length on off, the batsman plays it towards point for a run.
Jasprit Bumrah is into the attack.
Another shortish delivery, chopped to point.
Shortish delivery outside off, Pushpakumara fails to cut it away.

LBW appeal! Tossed up around leg, Pushpakumara looks to play it across the line but misses. The ball lobs off the pads ahead and Dhoni collects it. They appeal for both, lbw and catch but the umpire stays put for both. The replays show that there was no inside edge and it was going down leg
Malinda prods forward and blocks it.

Run out chance missed! Shortish delivery, Pushpakumara mistimes his pull towards square leg. Manish Pandey gets to the ball and seeing the non-striker out of his crease, hurls a flat throw towards his bowler. Dananjaya has to turns back quickly and dive to get in. However, he is not in danger as Kuldeep makes a mess of it. He fubles and fails to pick the ball. A big chance goes down.
Tossed up around leg, driven back to the bowler.
Kuldeep Yadav is brought back into the attack.
Dananjaya flays it towards cover from within the crease.
Full outside off,pushed through covers for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Malinda Pushpakumara, the debutant is the new man in.

OUT! Patel gets the big fish! Bowls it beautifully, slower through the air and wide outside off. Mathews tries to go after the bowler with a big hoick. However, the ball spins away and he has to fetch for it. Catches the top edge and it balloons towards Shardul Thakur at short third man, who doesn't make any mistake. Mathews walks back after playing a good knock. This will boost his confidence for the coming matches!
FOUR! Mathews stands tall! Fired in on middle and leg, Mathews kneels down and sweeps it uppishly through square leg for a boundary.
Hat-trick of play and a miss! Full and wide outside off, Dananjaya looks to drive but misses again.
Full outside off, slanting away, Dananjaya looks to flay it away on the off side but misses again.
Wide outside off, angling away, Akila looks to squeeze it out but misses.
Angling into the batsman, nudged in front of square on the leg side for a single.

Mathews decides to dance down the track and tries to slam the back of a length delivery. Fails to get his timing right but gets enough behind it and clears the mid off fielder. The man there chases it down and keeps them down to a brace.
Knuckle delivery from Pandya, punched on the up to covers.
Mathews pulls out at the last moment as there was some movement behind the sightscreen.
Wide! Pitches it wide outside off, Mathews leaves it and gets a wide.
Dananjaya prods forward and places towards mid on.
Wide outside off, slapped past the extra cover fielder for a single.
Darted into the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Fuller around middle and leg, eased down to long on for a single.
Served around leg, clipped to mid-wicket.
Full and sliding across, guided to short third man.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Shortish delivery, tucked through backward square leg for a brace.
The batsman has played it to the point region.
Back of a length delivery outside off, tapped in the cover region for a single.
Banged in short, Akila sways away and gets out of the line.
Short and angling away, Dananjaya keeps the bat inside the line and lets it go.
Hardik Pandya comes into the attack.
Akila Dananjaya comes out to bat.

OUT! No, the dive doesn't save him! Arm ball around off, turned on the leg side. Hasaranga from the other end takes off for a single but Mathews isn't interested in it, seeing Bumrah get to the ball in a hurry. Wanidu has a long way to track back and Jasprit hurls an accurate throw towards his bowler. Axar Patel just parries it onto the stumps as Hasaranga puts in a dive. The umpire goes upstairs and the replay shows that the Lankan is well short of his crease. The struggle continues for them and Mathews keeps running out of partners!
They have referred for run out at the non-striker's end. The Indians look confident. Will the dive save Hasaranga?

FOUR! Now, Mathews gets into the act! Full and sliding into the batsman, Mathews kneels down and slog sweeps it wide of long on. Pandya in the deep, runs to his right but the ball is far from him. 15 runs off the over already!
Served wide outside off, flayed through covers for a single.
SIX! This time it's even better! Flat outside off, Hasaranga dances down the track and tonks it straight down the ground. Connects it off the meat and the ball gets dumped into the stands.

FOUR! One bounce and into the fence! Full around off, Hasaranga kneels down and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket. Gets it in the gap and the ball crosses the fence on the bounce. A boundary is signalled!
Arm ball around off, coming in with the arm. Hasaranga opens the face of the bat and guides it towards short third man.
Time for Drinks.
Length outside off, Hasaranga guides it down to third man for a run.
Shorter in length on middle, Mathews pulls it by keeping it down through square leg for a run.
Good length on off, Mathews pushes it back to the bowler.
Angelo comes down the track, Shardul spots it and bangs it in short. Mathews goes for the pull but misses.
Shorter outside off, Mathews goes for the pull but gets a bottom edge and on the bounce to the bowler.
Back of a length on off, Mathews plays it towards point.
Quicker on off, Hasaranga pushes it to wide mid off.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Driven down to long off for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, Hasaranga drives it through covers for a run.
Bowls an arm ball on off, Hasaranga goes back and chops it to point.
FOUR! Hasaranga joins the party now. Picks his spot perfectly as there was no man out there. Flatter on the stumps, Wanidu goes down on one knee and sweeps it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Mathews taking the charge! He dances down the track and drills it hard past mid on. The ball races away to the fence in a flash. That was hit hard!
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
34th ODI fifty for Angelo Mathews.

Mathews gets to his half century! The ball is pitched wide outside off, Mathews stretches his arms and cuts it past the point fielder for a single. It has been a good knock from the ex-skipper but he has not got the support from the other end.

In the air... but in no man's land. Banged in short around off, angling in. Hasaranga goes for the pull but the ball gets big on him. Ends up getting a top edge and the ball skies over square leg. The man stationed there runs backwards while the fine leg fielder runs ahead. However, the ball falls between the duo and a single is picked up.
Hasaranga makes room and dabs it towards point.
Good length delivery, tapped to point.
Shardul Thakur is back on!
Shorter in length outside off, Hasaranga punches it through covers of a run.

Quicker outside off, Hasaranga dabs it towards short third man. He wants a run but is sent back by his parnter again. Dhoni collects the throw and takes the bails off. The Indians appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Fuller outside off, Angelo drives it through covers for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Mathews drives it to covers.
Works it around the corner with the angle for a run.

NOT OUT! Flatter outside off, Hasaranga cuts it towards backward point and sets off for a run but is sent back by his partner. The fielder fires in a flat throw to Dhoni who whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays show that the batsman had made his crease.
The umpire has gone upstairs to check for a run out at the striker's end.
Rohit Sharma is off the field!
Length ball on off, Hasaranga guides it down to third man to get off the mark.
Good length on off, Wanidu defends it off the front foot.
Bangs in a bouncer on middle, Hasaranga ducks under it. That was also close to a wide. The umpire gives it one for the over.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
WIDE! Another one! Similar length and line. Batsman evades it and the umpire calls it a wide.
WIDE! Gets carried away and bangs in a short one down the leg side. The batsman ducks under it and the umpire signals a wide.
Wanidu Hasaranga strides out to bat.

OUT! Just like last time, he takes the wicket after being hit for a biggie. He gets his second. Fuller in length outside off, Siriwardana goes for the expansive drive but gets an outside edge to the keeper who takes it and starts celebrating. Siriwardana is walking back after playing another good cameo. Sri Lanka are 5 down now and they require another 235 runs in 130 balls.
SIX! A great pick-up shot there by Siriwardana. Comes from around the wicket and angles it full into the pads. Milinda with the angle, flicks it over the fence at mid-wicket for a maximum.
Plays with the spin towards fine leg for a run.
Quicker on the stumps, Siriwardana tucks it to mid-wicket.
Drives it down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, Mathews drives it back to the bowler.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
FOUR! Bowls a round arm delivery down the leg side, Mathews tickles it fine down the leg side for a boundary. That was too easy for him.
Bowls it on a length on middle, Siriwardana defends it solidly.
FOUR! Lovely timing! Back of a length delivery wide outside off, Siriwardana slashes it through covers for a boundary. That made a cracking sound of the bat.
Good length on off, Mathews works it on the leg side for a run.
FOUR! SLAMMED! Shorter in length on off, Mathews pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Off pace delivery outside off, Milinda drives it through covers for a run.
Lands it on a length on middle, Siriwardana guides it to point.
Hardik Pandya is brought back into the attack.
The batsman has driven it straight back to the bowler.
Tosses it up on off, coming in with the arm. Mathews drives it back to the bowler.
Fuller in length on off, Angelo drives it to covers.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Poor, poor ball. Short and on leg stump. Siriwardana camps back and pulls it powerfully through square leg for a boundary.
Quicker outside off, Siriwardana goes for the cut but misses.
WIDE! Patel fires it down the leg side. Siriwardana fails to paddle and the umpire signals a wide.
Floats it on middle, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
Quicker on the stumps, Siriwardana sweeps it through square leg for a single.
Works it with spin towards mid-wicket for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, Siriwardana pushes it through the off side for a run.
TURN! Beautifully bowled! Loopy ball on off, turns away. Milinda tries to defend but gets beaten. The length and the speed of the ball was the key there.
Gives it air on middle, turning away. Siriwardana drives it to covers.

FOUR! They need a lot more of these! Slower through the air on off, Mathews clubs it over mid-wicket. The ball fall and starts rolling towards the fence. Pandya from mid on tries chasing it down, puts a in a desperate dive ahead. Gets his hands to ball and tries to pull it in but to his dismay the ball still rolls to the fence.
Quicker on off, Mathews mistimes his drive back towards the bowler. Patel dives to his left and makes a good stop.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Plays it with soft hands in front of covers for a run.
Fuller outside off, the batsman drives it to covers.
Flatter on off, Mathews flicks it through the leg side for a run.
Drags his length back outside off, the batsman cuts it to point.

Loopy ball on off, Siriwardana plays it in front of point and wants a single but is sent back by his partner. The fielder there is quick to the ball and hurls an underarm throw to Dhoni who deflects it onto the stumps. The Indians appeal but the umpire shakes his head. The replays show that Siriwardana had his bat firmly grounded.
Fuller outside off, Siriwardana drives it to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air, Mathews flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Bowls a googly on middle, Mathews fails to pick it but does well to adjust and keep it out.
Very full outside off, Siriwardana jams it out to covers.
Angles it into the pads, Mathews flicks it around the corner for a run.
Plays it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
BEATEN! Quicker outside off, Siriwardana plays for the turn but there ain't any. He is beaten on the outside edge.
Darts it on leg stump, the batsman works it to backward square leg.
Fires it down the leg side, Mathews misses the flick and the ball goes off the pads towards short fine leg for a leg bye.
Fuller on off, the batsman drives it to covers.

SIX! That is going, going and gone. Great use of the feet there by Siriwardana. Comes down the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hits it over the long on fence. There was a fielder there but it cleared him quite easily.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Slower through the air on the stumps, Mathews flicks it towards square leg for a run.
Loopy ball outside off, turning away. Siriwardana drives it through covers for a run.
Tucks it around the corner with the spin for a run.
Full around off, skidding on, Siriwardana kneels down to sweep. Gets it off the inner half to fine leg. A brace is taken. Had he not connected, he would have been caught plumb.
Darts it on off, Mathews punches it past extra cover and down to long off for a run.
Tosses it up outside off, the batsman drives it to covers.
Fires it on off, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
Flighted ball on off, Mathews drives it to mid off.
Flatter on off, Siriwardana pushes it down to long on for a run.
Axar Patel is into the attack now.
Plays it with the spin towards mid-wicket.
Bowls the googly on off, Siriwardana goes back and pushes it through the off side for a run.
Gives it air, landing it outside off, Siriwardana drives it towards point. He wants a run but is sent back by his partner.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Tosses it up on off, Milinda defends it off the front foot.
Loopy ball on off, Siriwardana drives it back to the bowler.
Comes around the wicket and bowls it outside off, Thirimanne cuts it through covers for a run.
Just ahead of a length outside off, Mathews pushes it to sweeper cover for a run.
WIDE! Angles it down the leg side, Mathews misses the flick and the umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! CRUNCHED! Bowls a bouncer, Mathews swivels inside the crease and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Bowls a knuckle ball outside off, shapes away after pitching. Mathews is beaten as he tries to drive.
Back of a length outside off, the batsman punches it through covers for a run.
FOUR! Poor line! Length ball outside off, width on offer. Siriwardana cashes in and cuts it through point for a boundary.
Floats it on middle, Siriwardana drives it down to long on for a run.
Fuller on the stumps, it is driven straight back to the bowler.
Quicker on the stumps, the batsman defends it off the back foot.
Loopy ball on off, Siriwardana pushes it to covers.
Works it around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Gift for Mathews but still has to be put away. A full toss outside off, it might have slipped out of his hand. Angelo leans into it and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Milinda Siriwardana walks out to bat.

OUT! Pandya gets his revenge! Having been hit for a biggie in the previous ball, Pandya gets his man the next ball. Thirimanne would consider himself a touch unlucky as that was hit really well but picked out the fielder there. Shorter outside off this time. Lahiru cuts it uppishly. Dhawan at deep point runs to his right and takes a very good catch on the move. Thirimanne cannot believe it. He walks back dejected. The fourth one is down for the Lankans.
SIX! BANG! A much-needed one for the home side. Pandya bangs in a short ball. Thirimanne latches onto it in a flash and pulls it over the fine leg fence for a maximum.
Back of a length on middle, Mathews shuffles across and tucks it to deep square leg for a run.
Angles it into the pads, Mathews plays it towards mid-wicket. Thirimanne wanted a run but was sent back by Mathews.
BEATEN! A slower delivery outside off, on the shorter side. Mathews tries to guide it down to third man but gets beaten.
Lands it on a length on off, Mathews defends it watchfully off the back foot.
Change of ends for Hardik Pandya!
Works it with the spin through mid-wicket for a run.
Flatter on off, Lahiru camps back and cuts it through covers for a run.
Loopy ball on off, Thirimanne lunges forward and blocks it.
Bowls it on middle, Mathews flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Floats it on off, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
Tosses it up on off, the batsman drives it down to long off for a run.
Kuldeep Yadav is now into the attack.
Time for Drinks.
Full around off, driven off the front foot back to the bowler.
Full outside off, pushed to covers.

Shout for lbw, turned down! On a good length, angling in. Skids on as well. Mathews is beaten in his forward defence and gets rapped on the pads. The players appeal but it's turned down. India don't opt for the review and even if they had, it would have been a waste as the Hawk Eye shows it to be going past the leg pole.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Once again Kohli drops it short and angling down leg. Mathews goes back and works it through the same region. The result is also the same. Kohli giving easy runs to the Lankans.
FOUR! Poor delivery, punished! Short and sliding down leg, Mathews camps back and tucks it to perfection. It goes through the backward square leg region and to the fence there.
Straying on the pads, worked to short fine leg.
Short and angling across, Thirimanne dances down and has a big swing at it but misses it completely. Lahiru has started to look desperate for runs!
Good length delivery around leg, the ball holds a touch. Thirimanne is early into the shot and almost chips it to Sharma at mid-wicket. Luckily for him, it goes on the bounce to Rohit.
Banged in short, angling away, Thirimanne gets under the ball and looks to ramp it over the keeper's head but misses it completely.
Back of a length delivery, angling down leg, Mathews shuffles across and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full outside off, jammed out to covers.
Back of a length delivery, punched in the cover region. He wants a single but Thirimanne isn't interested.
Fuller on the pads, flicked away nicely. Rohit Sharma at mid-wicket, dives to his right and makes a wonderful stop.
Another low full toss outside off, drilled to long off for a single.
High full toss, punched to long on for a single.
Fuller around leg, pushed back to the bowler.
Slower through the air around middle and off, driven through mid on for a single.
A friendly full toss to start off by Kohli, eased down to long off for a single.
Now, that's a surprise! Virat Kohli experiments with himself with the ball. Will his dibbly-dobbly stuff work?
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Mathews gets on his toes and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Banged in short, Mathews bends backwards and lets it go to the keeper.
Good length delivery, angling across. Lahiru plays a punchy drive through covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery around off, Angelo looks to defend from within the crease but gets it off the inside edge on the leg side. A single is taken.
Pandya starts his spell with a bouncer. Mathews ducks under it and lets it through to the keeper.
Hardik Pandya is into the attack. He has a slip in place for him.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled. A maximum of four fielders are allowed outside the circle till the 40th over.

Just short! On a good length outside off, Mathews pokes at it. Gets an outside edge which falls just in front of Rohit Sharma at second slip. The Indian opener does well to dive to his right and make a half stop. The ball ricochets behind and a single is taken.
Banged in short, Mathews sways away from the ball.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fuller one around middle and off, pushed with soft hands towards mid off. A single is taken.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Length delivery around leg, tucked to mid-wicket.
Full and angling in, pushed with the angle to mid on.
The batsman has played that off the back foot and into the ground.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Angling away from the southpaw, Thirimanne looks to flay it away but misses it completely. Thakur appeals but is the only one appealing.
Straying on the pads again, clipped to mid-wicket.
Around leg, pushed to mid on.
Angelo Mathews is the new man in. He has to step up for the hosts to make a match of this.

OUT! Dhoni, you beauty! He has got another one right! What a 300th ODI he is having. Bumrah bowls it on a back of a length, angling down leg. Munaweera flirts with it but seems to have missed it as the ball lands in Dhoni's gloves. He once again hears something and starts appealing. The umpire stays put and India go for the review again. Replays show that the front foot is fine and Ultra Edge detects ball brushing the glove once again. Another superb use of review by the visitors. Dhoni is having a great time behind the stumps. Bumrah adds another to his tally of wickets in the series. Sri Lanka have been rocked hard early.
Once again Dhoni has heard something when Munaweera tried flirting with a delivery down the leg side. Kohli has opted for the review.
Fullish outside off, pushed to mid off.
Slight halt in play as Munaweera needs the attention of the physio.

OUCH! Back of a length delivery, jags back in. Munaweera goes for the pull but misses. The ball hits him on the forearm and gets deflected on the back thigh. He seems hurt and so has called on for the physio.
Shortish delivery around middle and off, Dilshan gets across and blocks it.

FOUR! Up and over! On a good length outside off, Munaweera just lofts it through the line. It's played on the up and the ball sails over the man at mid off and to the fence there. Sri Lanka want more of this!
A back of a length delivery around off, straightens a touch. Munaweera looks to play it across the line but gets beaten by the movement off the deck.
Short around middle, Lahiru covers the line of the ball and defends.
Wide! Down the leg side, Lahiru gets across to flick it away but misses. A wide is signalled.
Short and angling across. Thirimanne gets on his toes and blocks it into the deck.
Fullish around off, driven back to the bowler.
FOUR! Nicely done! A touch ahead of a length around off, angling away. Thirimanne drives it on the up. Gets it through the gap in the cover-point region for a boundary.
Full outside off, tapped to covers.
Short of a length delivery around leg, Thirimanne gets across and tucks in on the leg side.
Fuller in length on off, Dilshan drives it to mid on.

Again a delivery from wide of the crease. Angles it into the batsman. Munaweera tries to defend but gets beaten and is struck on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire remains put. The ball might be missing leg there.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Back of a length on off, Munaweera pushes it through cover-point for a brace.
Lahiru Thirimanne strides out to bat. He has scored 50-plus in his last three ODIs against India.

OUT! A run out. Needless, the last thing Sri Lanka wanted. Bumrah bowls it from wide of the crease and on a length around off. Munaweera defends it towards Rahul at point. Mendis sets off for a run but is sent back by his partner. The ball bounces right into the hands of Lokesh who scores a direct hit at the non-striker's end. The Indians appeal and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that Mendis was well short of his crease. Sri Lanka have lost another and are in big trouble now. Mendis, the big fish is walking back.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a run out at the non-striker's end. Direct hits are always close and the Indians seem quite confident about it.
Lovely delivery! Fuller in length on off, Munaweera walks down the track and tries to drive but is beaten by the away movement.
Angles it on the pads, Munaweera flicks it to deep square leg for a run.
Fuller in length outside off, Mendis plays it down to third man for a run.
This lad is cracking up some good pace here! Lands it on a length around off, straightens a touch. Mendis from within his crease tries to work it on the off side but gets beaten.
Back of a length on off, Mendis goes back and across as he defends it.
Good length around off, Mendis pokes at it and gets beaten.
Length ball around off, Munaweera tries to force it through the off side but gets an outside edge down to third man for a run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

Good length on off, nips back in. Munaweera tries to push it through the off side but gets an inside edge towards square leg and sets off for a run. The fielder is quick to the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but misses. A run added to the total.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Back of a length on off, Dilshan rocks back and defends it.
Lands it on a length, jags back into the batsman. Munaweera tries to defend but is struck on the thigh pad.
Goes wide of the crease and bowls it on a length. Munaweera defends it solidly.
Lands it on a length around off, Mendis tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Kusal Mendis is the new man in.

OUT! Shardul Thakur gets his first international wicket! A lot of credit should be given to Dhoni there. A brilliant review by him. A big, big wicket, Dickwella is walking back. Thakur bangs in a short one down the leg side. Niroshan shuffles and goes for the flick but misses. The ball goes off something to Dhoni who catches it and appeals. The umpire shakes his head and signals a wide. Dhoni says he heard a noise and asks Virat to review. Kohli does so and the umpire goes upstairs. Replays show that there was a spike on Ultra Edge as the ball passed the glove. The on-field call has to be overturned. Thakur is delighted as Sri Lanka lose their first.

There is review for a caught behind by India against Dickwella. Dhoni is quite confident about it as he informs his skipper that he has heard some sound. Kohli puts his faith in the keeper and takes the review.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
WOAH! That delivery was 148 kph. Thakur comes running in and lands it on a length on off, the ball spits off the wicket. Dickwella tries to defend it but gets beaten.
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off, Niroshan tries to go after it but misses. The umpire signals a wide.
FOUR! Starts off the over with a boundary. Shorter on leg stump. Dickwella comes in line and pulls it through square leg for a boundary.
Slower ball outside off, Dickwella guides it down to third man for a run. 14 runs from the over.
Bouncer outside off, Dickwella goes for the upper cut but gets beaten.
Better from Bumrah! Lands it on a length around off, Dickwella tries to defend it but gets an inside edge onto the ground.

FIVE WIDES! Bumrah has not got it right in the first over. Bowls an inswinger down the leg side. Dickwella lets it be. Dhoni dives to his right to collect it but fails to do so. The ball races down to the fine leg fence. The umpire also signals a wide.
FOUR! This is even better than the shot a couple of balls ago! A touch ahead of a length on middle, Dickwella whips it over mid-wicket for a boundary. The Lankans are on the charge here.
Fuller in length outside off, Dickwella goes for the drive but gets beaten.
FOUR! Easy for Dickwella. Bumrah bowls it on the pads, Dickwella flicks it over the square leg fielder for a boundary.
The in-form Jasprit Bumrah will bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
First runs for Munaweera in ODI cricket! Length delivery outside off, Dilshan camps back and pushes it through cover-point. The fielder from point gives it chase and keeps it down to two.
Back of a length on off, the batsman pushes it to covers.
BEATEN! Lovely stuff. Lands it on a length around off, straightens a touch. Munaweera tries to defend it but gets beaten.
Length ball around off, seams away from the batsman. Munaweera makes room and tries to go over the infield but misses. He has show his intent here.
A well-directed short ball on middle, gets big on the batsman. Munaweera defends it off the back foot. Looks quick this guy.
Starts off with a length delivery on off, shapes back in sharply. Dickwella chops it down to third man for a run. He was also surprised by the inward movement. The Lankans are underway.

The players are out in the middle. Nirsohan Dickwell to open with Dilshan Munaweera today. Debutant Shardul Thakur to start the proceedings with the first new ball. He has a couple of slips in place. Here we go...
